title: social.post.video_attached v1
description: A post was created with the author's own short social video (purpose SOCIAL, task SOC-2b, ADR-049). video-svc sets media.videos.attached_at so the video is not deleted as never attached. Idempotent. Producer: social-svc (outbox, same transaction as the post). Consumer: video-svc.

video_id.description: A SOCIAL video owned by author_id.

author_id.description: Post author; video-svc acts only if it owns the video.
